comments: Client-cert SAN suffix policy is implemented:
- Config surface: Config struct and LoadConfig() in config.go add ClientCertSanSuffixAllowList, loaded from AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX.
- Enforcement: server.go enforces the policy both at HTTP request entry (enforceClientCertSanSuffixPolicy) and at TLS handshake (tls.Config.VerifyConnection).
Client-cert subject/serial audit logging on session.start is present: auditSessionStart logs client_cert_subject and client_cert_serial (and also mtls_* fields for redundancy).
No regression of TLS1.2+/mTLS/cipher suite restrictions: TLS config still enforces MinVersion TLS1.2, explicit cipher suites, and ClientAuth: RequireAndVerifyClientCert.
Deployment wires the new env var: deployment.yaml adds AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX with documentation.
No issues found; implementation is robust and covers all requirements. The duplicate mtls_* fields in audit logs are redundant but harmless.
